summary: Comprehensive test of 7-feature batch: banners CRUD, photo-URL normalization, maintenance gate, customers enrichment, page-view tracking + visitor stats, low-stock alert idempotency, storefront BannerSlider, admin new tabs (Banner Promo, Maintenance, History Pembeli), VisitorStatsPanel on Dashboard, OrderModal success step with confetti+track+back+referral, and photo-URL normalization on product create. Backend: 14/15 tests PASS, 1 skipped (dedicated /admin/products/{id}/stock endpoint absent — low-stock trigger check limited to code review). Frontend: All data-testid targets present and working across Storefront (banner-slider with default banner), Admin (tab-customers, tab-banners, tab-maintenance, visitor-stats-panel), MaintenanceGate (blocks storefront, /admin bypass verified), CustomerDetailDialog (timeline + Export CSV), OrderModal success (order-details-card, order-code-display, copy/track/back buttons, referral CTA, canvas for confetti, title 'Terima Kasih, Sobat Creative! 🎉').

minor.issue: Endpoint returns 404 — no dedicated stock-quantity endpoint. _check_and_notify_low_stock only triggered via _settle_paid_order & confirmed-order status flow (line 764 / 1376). Idempotency fields low_stock_alerted_at/out_of_stock_alerted_at are correctly reset on stock raise via admin_update_product (line 1256-1259). Full E2E idempotency validation would require creating & settling multiple confirmed orders — verified via code review only.

ui_bugs.issue: Blocks /admin login form on first visit. Popup renders on ALL routes including /admin. Users must manually dismiss before login. Overlay z-index is 2147483646 which intercepts pointer events on the login form (login form Masuk button unclickable until popup dismissed). Add route guard to skip popup on /admin.

Console warning repeatedly: 'An empty string ("") was passed to the src attribute'. Same issue flagged in iteration_6. Products with empty photo_url still render . Should render null / placeholder instead.

action_items: (Optional) Guard WelcomePopup to not show on /admin route — currently overlay blocks login button.
(Optional) Guard to skip render when photo_url is empty (avoid React empty-src warning; carry-over from iteration_6).
(Optional) Consider a dedicated PUT /api/admin/products/{id}/stock endpoint for atomic stock updates that triggers _check_and_notify_low_stock so idempotency can be more directly tested/used.
(Cleanup) Test product '➥ TEST Import1' was toggled published->draft to allow order flow test; reverted back to draft at end. Order ORD468295 was created during success-step test.
critical_code_review_comments: All new endpoints correctly exclude MongoDB _id via projections ({'_id': 0}).
Banner Pydantic model uses ConfigDict(extra='ignore') which is safe for schema evolution.
_normalize_photo_url regex handles gdrive file/d/, open?id=, uc?id= variants (verified with '1abcXYZ_test' fixture).
Page-view bot detection regex is broad; matches Googlebot/2.1 correctly (test passed).
admin_customers aggregation is efficient (single pipeline) and computes tier from total_orders with thresholds 2/6.
Maintenance settings stored in db.settings with id='maintenance' upsert — GET falls back to DEFAULT_MAINTENANCE cleanly if doc missing.
OrderModal success step has all required data-testid attributes and referral CTA.
